$comment: Praxis artifact details: titles, descriptions, groups and the session each file was saved from. Paths are repository-relative. Safe to edit or delete.

records.title: artifacts-home-1-quiet-gallery.html
records.description: 1 · Quiet Gallery (updated) — 4 columns, icon filters, no side rail

records.title: composer-1-command-strip.html
records.description: 1 · Command Strip: one quiet line that grows as you type, with a / command palette and a flying send

records.title: composer-2-dock-satellites.html
records.description: 2 · Dock & Satellites: context chips float around the composer; drop files, pop chips off, pull them in on send

records.title: composer-3-split-ledger.html
records.description: 3 · Split Ledger: prompt next to a live list of context with animated ticks and a budget bar

records.title: composer-4-stack-of-cards.html
records.description: 4 · Stack of Cards: queue, fan, reorder and run follow-up prompts in order

records.title: composer-5-ambient-canvas.html
records.description: 5 · Ambient Canvas: no box, type onto a glowing line that also shows the agent's status

records.title: shelf-1-library-spines.html
records.description: 1 · Library Spines: books pull out and open like a cover; swaying bookmark for running sessions

records.title: shelf-10-genie-dock.html
records.description: 10 · Genie Dock: magnifying dock, bounce for attention, cards pour out of the icon with a genie effect

records.title: shelf-2-rolodex.html
records.description: 2 · Rolodex: spin a card wheel by scroll, drag or arrow keys; the card in the window flips down as the preview

records.title: shelf-3-filing-tabs.html
records.description: 3 · Filing Tabs: folders slide out of a drawer by their tab; status lights; click to pin with a paperclip

records.title: shelf-4-liquid-bubbles.html
records.description: 4 · Liquid Bubbles: droplets stretch into cards with a gooey effect; status rings; new sessions drip up the rail

records.title: shelf-5-timeline-ribbons.html
records.description: 5 · Timeline Ribbons: sessions hang at the time they were last active; scrub along the timeline to unroll their cards

records.title: shelf-6-aurora-glass.html
records.description: 6 · Aurora Glass: frosted rail over a moving aurora; tiles that lean toward the pointer; tilting glass cards; sparks on reply

records.title: shelf-7-neon-equalizer.html
records.description: 7 · Neon Equalizer: synthwave; equaliser bars show status; cards trace a neon outline then flicker on

records.title: shelf-8-constellation.html
records.description: 8 · Constellation: stars over a drifting starfield; cards warp in from a flaring star; shooting star for new sessions

records.title: shelf-9-origami-paper.html
records.description: 9 · Origami Paper: light theme; washi-tape status on paper tags; cards unfold panel by panel; paper plane for new sessions
